What this project explores

Demand & inventory patterns

Review demand by category and across time, alongside inventory value and product-level details.

Inventory policies

Compare average reorder point and safety stock across product categories to understand inventory buffers.

Replenishment visibility

Identify items marked as requiring reorder and review the report’s recommended quantities by category.

Interpretation note: the recommended order quantity is the replenishment quantity represented in this dashboard; it is not presented as a fully optimized procurement model.
